historical_event.name: SpaceX Starship First Test Flight
historical_event.description: SpaceX's Starship, the most powerful rocket ever made with 33 booster engines, launches in a historic first test flight from Boca Chica, Texas, and explodes four minutes into flight.

techmeme.headline: NSA Using Anthropic's Mythos Despite Pentagon Blacklist
techmeme.context: NSA usa el modelo Mythos de Anthropic a pesar de la prohibición del Pentágono, citando la necesidad existencial de entender la "falla de día cero infinita".

techmeme.headline: Vercel Security Breach via Compromised Third-Party AI Tool
techmeme.context: Brecha de seguridad en Vercel mediante herramienta de IA de terceros comprometida; hackers venden datos por $2M.

techmeme.headline: Apple WWDC 2026: Revamped Siri Interface Teased
techmeme.context: Apple insinúa interfaz renovada de Siri para iOS 27 en el WWDC 2026, con personalización de pantalla de inicio.

sciencedaily.headline: Dragonflies Can See Colors Humans Can't
sciencedaily.summary: Dragonflies can detect extremely deep red light, pushing beyond human visual limits. Surprisingly, they use the same molecular trick humans evolved to achieve this capability.

bigthink.headline: The first homes on Mars may be alive
bigthink.relevance: Explora soluciones innovadoras para la colonización espacial utilizando biología sintética y conceptos de hábitats vivos.
